name: route-registration-single-source
prompt: main.go registers routes inline in main(). Extract route registration into one function: func routes() *http.ServeMux that creates a fresh ServeMux, registers every endpoint, and returns it. main() then uses http.Server{Addr: ":8080", Handler: routes()}. Behavior must not change: all endpoints keep working through the returned mux. This is the standard seam that later tests and shutdown work build on, so main() must contain no HandleFunc calls.
